name: crystal-structure-distortion-analysis
description: Analyze local tetrahedral and octahedral coordination-polyhedron distortions from VASP POSCAR/CONTCAR structures.

required: One VASP5/6 POSCAR or CONTCAR structure file with element symbols on the species line.
Coordinates in Direct or Cartesian mode; Selective dynamics is accepted and ignored.

configuration.config_file: Optional JSON config; without it the default FeO4/CrO6 configuration is used.
configuration.centers: Each configured center species supplies a ligand species, coordination number, and geometry; only coordination 4/tetrahedron and 6/octahedron are supported.
configuration.search_radius_angstrom: Positive ligand-image search radius in Angstrom.
configuration.shell_gap_warning_angstrom: Positive nth/(n+1)th shell-gap warning threshold in Angstrom.
configuration.output_prefix: Optional local output prefix; default is polyhedral_distortion.
configuration.dry_run: Optional flag that validates POSCAR/config and prints the plan without writing files.

units.structure: VASP lattice and Cartesian geometry are in Angstrom (A).
units.distance: Bond and shell-gap distances are in Angstrom (A).
units.angle: Angles and angular deviations are in degree; angle variance is degree^2.
units.dimensionless: Delta-d, Baur D, coefficient of variation, and quadratic elongation are dimensionless.
units.q_metrics: Q2, Q3, and QJT are in Angstrom (A).

assumptions: The caller supplies and scientifically justifies chemical center/ligand species and coordination number; the extension does not infer oxidation state, bond valence, or coordination chemistry.
Periodic ligand images are sorted by center-ligand distance and the nearest configured coordination number is selected.
Site numbering is 1-based in POSCAR atom order.
Only tetrahedral coordination 4 and octahedral coordination 6 are implemented.
Dry-run performs no local output write and no remote or scheduler operation.

artifacts: stdout summary for ordinary runs, or a JSON dry-run payload
output_contract.stdout: Ordinary runs report analyzed site count, warning count, and the three selected local output paths. Dry-run reports the resolved input/configuration plan as JSON and writes no files.
output_contract.json_schema: The JSON artifact has schema_version 1.0 and contains analysis/tool_version, provenance (absolute input path, input SHA-256, config path, resolved config), structure, warnings, site_results, and summary.

json_fields: provenance.input_sha256: SHA-256 of the input structure
provenance.config_file: resolved config path when supplied

units.dimensionless: Delta-d, Baur D, coefficient of variation, and quadratic elongation

failure_markers: Expected POSCAR/configuration/geometry failures do not produce a successful result payload.
output_contract.side_effects: Normal runs may overwrite same-name local output files selected by the caller; the extension does not touch remote files, invoke SSH/PBS, submit a scheduler job, or write outside that local prefix.

authorization_policy.notes: No remote, SSH, PBS, scheduler, or external-service operation is performed. The experimental status requires explicit workflow approval before selection.

source_provenance.notes: The preserved original source is packaged inside this extension. The runtime implementation comes from the migrated refactored source at src/crystal_distortion.py, while the geometry algorithm and bundle behavior remain consistent.

migration_metadata.bundle_manifest: The bundle custom manifest was not used directly because the host requires fpilot.extension.v1 and host registry locks.
migration_metadata.geometry_boundary: Q2/Q3 use sorted octahedral pair-average lengths for reproducible scalar output; they are not crystallographic directions. QJT is a scalar amplitude, and directional interpretation requires an externally defined local-axis convention.
migration_metadata.pytest_receipt: Any pytest receipt shipped in the source bundle is historical bundle evidence, not a real-time test of this host environment. The current .venv-figure environment lacks pytest, so this extension remains experimental.
